_about: Vendor paid-media dashboards the AI team watches read-only (Drew, 2026-09-28: the vendors will not give us Google Ads access, so the team reads what they share). The desktop task vendor-dash-read (daily about 12:45 AM) reads every source with status active in the Claude Browser and writes outputs/ai-team/vendor-dash/{date}/reads.jsonl; vendor_dash.py ingest validates each read, and vendor_dash.py report writes the night's deltas for Shaq. To turn on a new dashboard: paste its view link into url and set status to active. Nothing else changes. A source with dashboard_push.enabled also feeds the client dashboard (vendor_dash.py push, run by the same task after ingest). Never add a link that needs a sign-in.

scope_notes.vendor_ads: NabThat's own Google Ads account. No Cost box on the dashboard: spend is implied as clicks x Avg. CPC (converted), which is the cost per click in dollars, so the implied figure is good to about half a cent per click.
scope_notes.site_ga4: The WHOLE website in GA4, not NabThat's traffic. Verified 2026-09-28 against GA4 property 487046736: Sep 1 to 27 the dashboard showed 13,275 sessions and 70 form submissions; GA4 had 13,011 sessions and 71 asc_form_submission key events across all channels, and only 6,762 sessions and 19 form submissions from Paid Search (which includes Constellation's campaigns). Sun 9/27: dashboard 430 sessions, GA4 all channels 426, Paid Search 174. Never credit these three boxes to NabThat.

sources.note: Single page, date control at the top right reads the current range (default preset Last month). The panel's preset dropdown lists Yesterday, This month (sub-menu: This month to date), Last 7 days (sub-menu: Last month), Advanced. Scorecards: Impressions, Clicks, Avg. CPC, CTR, Calls from Ads (shown compact, e.g. 1K), Lead Forms, Website CTC, New VDP Views, Hours & Directions. Exact clicks and calls come from the Campaigns By Click table's Grand total row; spend is the sum of the Device x Cost table (every device, so the whole account), which this Looker shows and the monthly sheet does not. Scope: the Tier III language campaigns (Chinese, Spanish, Korean Performance Max and branding) only; the BMW Western Region vehicle listing ads are not in it, so its spend runs below the monthly sheet's New Century BMW (SEM) block (September 2026: $16,111 here vs $20,113 on the sheet).
interim: GA4: campaigns named constellation_* (today only constellation_2026_BMWWR_VLA, the vehicle listing ads, google / cpc and google / vehiclelisting). Constellation's Performance Max and branding campaigns are not tagged, so GA4 lumps them with NabThat's under (organic) and (not set).

Monthly sheet: one tab per closed month, named '{Month} {YYYY} (By Language)'; the BMW block is 'New Century BMW (SEM)' with campaign rows and a total row. August 2026 was the newest tab on 2026-09-28. The 'Jul-Sep' and 'Oct-Dec' tabs are from 2024; never read them as current.
The Tuesday email from reports@helloconstellation.com ('New Century BMW_OB_{date}.pdf') is an On-Brand Inventory pricing report, not ad results.
